svg.title: Hedgeway Meadows — Hedgerow stile
svg.desc: Broken garden walls, farm carts and stiles divide the meadow into three encounter glades. The fence-top route doubles back through a hay loft. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Broken garden walls, farm carts and stiles divide the meadow into three encounter glades.
The fence-top route doubles back through a hay loft.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
P1 Thistledown Lane · P2 Puffkin Pasture · P3 Village Square
Encounter: Hedge Nibbler · Common; repeatable solo combat AND equivalent aid/repair objective.
